digest.component_or_area: reconcile-bridge GHA workflow / tickets branch merge driver
propositions: reconcile-bridge.yml never sets merge.ours.driver, so the merge=ours attribute names an undefined driver on the GHA runner.
With the driver undefined, git falls back to a 3-way text merge of the large .bridge_state JSON instead of the intended local-wins behavior.
reconcile-bridge.yml must set merge.ours.driver=true for the tickets worktree before any merge step.
The canary workflow already obtains the driver via its existing rebar init call and must remain unedited, guarded by a regression assertion.

A reconverge against a diverged remote in a runner-shaped checkout should resolve .bridge_state/* local-wins with no conflict markers, while the same scenario without the config yields text-merge behavior as a negative control.
This change is a prerequisite for the CI blob:none clone filter, which removes merge-base blobs and would fault large blobs mid-merge while the driver is undefined.
